host.label: Address
host.help: Host name or IP address of the server.

username.label: User name on the server
username.help: The service user the setup commands create, normally alice-svc.

not_found.title: This service does not exist.
not_found.cause: The service was deleted, or the address is mistyped.
not_found.action: Open Services and choose the service again.

name_taken.title: A service with this name exists.
name_taken.cause: Service names are unique, whatever the letter case.

not_empty.title: The service still owns resources.
not_empty.cause: A service is deleted only when it owns no server, Key Vault, certificate, signing request, ACME certificate, SSH key or scan scope ({{count}} left).
not_empty.action: Move them to another service (Move here on that service's page), then delete this one.

default_protected.title: The Default service cannot be deleted.
default_protected.cause: Every resource without a service of its own belongs to the Default service.
default_protected.action: Rename it if you want, or leave it as it is.

untrusted.title: The destination service does not accept certificates and keys from the source service.
untrusted.cause: The certificate or SSH key belongs to one service and the server or Key Vault to another, and no trust lets the second accept the first one's keys. Automatic deployments stop there until a trust exists.
untrusted.action: An Administrator adds the trust on the service page (Trusts), or moves the server or the certificate to the same service. Then try again.

trust_exists.title: This trust exists.
trust_exists.cause: The service already accepts certificates and keys from the other service.

in_use.title: This environment is in use.
in_use.cause: A service or a role binding names the environment.
in_use.action: Give those services another environment (or none) first, then delete it.

key_taken.title: An environment with this key exists.

not_found.title: This page or item does not exist.
not_found.cause: The address may be mistyped, or the item was removed.
not_found.action: Check the address, or go back to the home page.

unavailable.title: Alice is temporarily unavailable.
unavailable.cause: Alice cannot reach its database, or it is still starting.
unavailable.action: Wait a minute and try again. If this continues, ask your administrator to check the Alice service.

bad_request.title: Alice could not read this request.
bad_request.cause: The request was incomplete, had fields Alice does not know, or contained text Alice cannot store (a NUL character or invalid UTF-8).
bad_request.action: Reload the page and try again. If you use the API, check the request against the API documentation.

body_too_large.title: The request is too large.
body_too_large.cause: Alice accepts at most 1 MiB of data in one request.
body_too_large.action: Send less data at once, or use a smaller file.

precondition_failed.title: Someone changed this item while you were editing it.
precondition_failed.cause: The item was changed after you opened it, so your change was not saved.
precondition_failed.action: Reload the page, check the current values and make your change again.

method_not_allowed.title: This request method is not accepted here.
method_not_allowed.cause: An export is downloaded with GET only; a HEAD request would run the whole export and record it without sending the file.
method_not_allowed.action: Download the file with GET, for example with the Export button.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong on our side.
unexpected.cause: Alice hit an unexpected problem while handling your request.
unexpected.action: Try again. If it happens again, give your administrator the request ID shown here.

limited.title: Too many requests in a short time.
limited.cause: Alice slows down repeated requests to protect accounts and the service.
limited.action: Wait a moment and try again.

failed.title: Some fields need your attention.
failed.cause: One or more values are missing or not in the expected format.
failed.action: Correct the highlighted fields and try again.

unauthenticated.title: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
unauthenticated.cause: You signed out, stayed inactive for 30 minutes, or reached the 12-hour session limit.

forbidden.title: You do not have permission to do this.
forbidden.cause: Your role does not include this action.
forbidden.action: Ask an administrator if you need access.

stepup_required.title: Please confirm it's you.
stepup_required.cause: This is a sensitive action, so Alice asks for a fresh verification code.
stepup_required.action: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, then try again.

csrf_failed.title: Alice blocked this request for your safety.
csrf_failed.cause: The request did not come from the Alice page, or the page is out of date.
csrf_failed.action: Reload the page and try again.

invalid_credentials.title: Incorrect username or password.
invalid_credentials.cause: The username or password is wrong, or the account is temporarily blocked after too many attempts.
invalid_credentials.action: Check your details and try again. After several failed attempts, wait 15 minutes.

mfa_invalid.title: The verification code is not correct.
mfa_invalid.cause: The code was mistyped, has already been used, or your device clock is wrong.
mfa_invalid.action: Wait for a new code in your authenticator app and enter it, or use a recovery code.

mfa_already_enrolled.title: Your authenticator app is already set up.
mfa_already_enrolled.cause: Two-step verification was already completed for this account.
mfa_already_enrolled.action: Enter a code from your authenticator app. If you lost the device, ask an administrator to reset it.

password_too_short.title: The password is too short.
password_too_short.cause: Passwords must have at least {{min}} characters.
password_too_short.action: Choose a longer password. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.

password_too_long.title: The password is too long.
password_too_long.cause: Passwords can have at most {{max}} characters.

password_breached.title: This password is too common.
password_breached.cause: It appears in a list of passwords that attackers try first.
password_breached.action: Choose a different password that you do not use anywhere else.

current_password_invalid.title: Your current password is not correct.
current_password_invalid.cause: Alice checks your current password before changing it.

try_again.title: Alice is busy with this account. Please try again.
try_again.cause: Another sign-in or verification for the same account was still running, so Alice could not check this one in time. Nothing was counted as a failed attempt.
try_again.action: Wait a second and try again.

username_taken.title: This username is already in use.
username_taken.cause: Usernames must be unique; upper and lower case count as the same.

last_admin.title: Alice needs at least one active administrator.
last_admin.cause: This change would leave no enabled local administrator who can sign in.
last_admin.action: Give another person the Administrator role first, then try again.

sso_user.title: This change is not possible for a single sign-on or directory user.
sso_user.cause: The role of a single sign-on or directory user comes from their groups. They have no Alice password and cannot create API tokens, and they confirm it's them at their identity provider or with their directory password.
sso_user.action: Change the user's groups at the identity provider or in the directory; disable the user here if they must stop at once.

scope_not_allowed.title: Your role does not allow this token access.
scope_not_allowed.cause: A token can never do more than its owner's role allows.

busy.title: Alice is already checking or exporting the audit log.
busy.cause: Alice reads the whole audit log for one check or export at a time, and another one is running. Nothing was checked or exported.
busy.action: Wait until the other check or export has finished, then try again.

forwarding_address_refused.title: Alice does not send audit entries to this address.
forwarding_address_refused.cause: The syslog receiver's address is a link-local (such as the cloud metadata address), multicast, unspecified or reserved address, which Alice never connects to. Nothing was saved or sent.
forwarding_address_refused.action: Enter the address of your syslog server or SIEM on your network, then save or send the test message again.

forwarding_unreachable.title: Alice could not reach the syslog receiver.
forwarding_unreachable.cause: The host name or port may be wrong, the receiver may be down, or a firewall blocks the connection. Audit entries stay queued and are sent when the receiver can be reached.
forwarding_unreachable.action: Check the host, port and transport, then send a test message again.

forwarding_untrusted.title: Alice does not trust the syslog receiver's certificate.
forwarding_untrusted.cause: The receiver's TLS certificate does not verify against the system's certificate authorities or the CA you entered, or it names another host. Nothing was sent.
forwarding_untrusted.action: Enter the certificate authority that issued the receiver's certificate, check the host name, then send a test message again.

code_invalid.title: The setup code is not correct.
code_invalid.cause: The code was mistyped or has been replaced by a newer one.
code_invalid.action: Type the code exactly as the installer printed it. Lost it? Ask the server administrator to run: alice setup-token --reset

locked.title: Too many wrong setup codes.
locked.cause: Alice blocks setup from this computer for 15 minutes after 5 wrong codes.
locked.action: Wait 15 minutes, then enter the code again.

session_expired.title: Your setup session ended.
session_expired.cause: The setup page was idle for 60 minutes, or setup was finished elsewhere.
session_expired.action: Enter the setup code again to continue.

enrollment_missing.title: Please fill in the administrator details first.
enrollment_missing.cause: The verification code step needs the administrator form from the previous step.
enrollment_missing.action: Go back one step and submit the administrator form again.

passphrase_too_short.title: The recovery passphrase is too short.
passphrase_too_short.cause: It must have at least {{min}} characters, because it protects all your backups.
passphrase_too_short.action: Choose a longer passphrase, for example four or five unrelated words.

passphrase_mismatch.title: The two passphrases are different.
passphrase_mismatch.cause: The passphrase and its repetition must match exactly.
passphrase_mismatch.action: Type the same passphrase in both fields.

passphrase_already_set.title: The recovery passphrase is already set.
passphrase_already_set.cause: It can be chosen only once during setup.

incomplete.title: Setup is not finished yet.
incomplete.cause: The recovery passphrase has not been chosen.
incomplete.action: Choose a recovery passphrase, then finish setup.

license_choice_missing.title: Setup is not finished yet.
license_choice_missing.cause: No license was uploaded and the evaluation was not started.
license_choice_missing.action: Upload a license file or choose Start 30-day evaluation, then finish setup.

passphrase_too_weak.title: The recovery passphrase is too easy to guess.
passphrase_too_weak.cause: The passphrase is long enough but rated fair: it uses too few different words or kinds of characters, or repeats and runs such as abcdef or 123456 make up most of it. It protects every backup, so Alice asks for a stronger one.
passphrase_too_weak.action: Use several unrelated words, or mix letters, digits and symbols without repeating the same characters or words, until the meter shows good or strong.

locked.title: Not available while the license is expired.
locked.cause: The license (or the evaluation) has ended, so Alice makes no changes to your servers. Your data is safe.
locked.action: An administrator can upload a renewed license on the License page. Everything works again at once.

invalid.title: This file is not a valid Alice license.
invalid.cause: The file may be damaged or edited, or it is not a license file.
invalid.action: Download the file again from your vendor's email and upload that file.

wrong_installation.title: This license file was made for a different installation (ending in {{got}}).
wrong_installation.cause: A license works only on the installation whose ID it names. This installation's ID ends in {{expected}}.
wrong_installation.action: Ask your vendor for a license for this installation and send them the Installation ID shown on this page.

unknown_key.title: This license was issued with a key this version of Alice does not know.
unknown_key.cause: The license is for a newer version of Alice, or it was not issued by your vendor.

revoked_key.title: This license was signed with a key that is no longer trusted.
revoked_key.cause: Your vendor replaced its signing key.
revoked_key.action: Ask your vendor for a new license file; they issue it free of charge.

unsupported_format.title: This license needs a newer version of Alice.
unsupported_format.cause: The file uses a format this version of Alice cannot read.
unsupported_format.action: Update Alice, then upload the file again. The current license stays in use meanwhile.

older_than_installed.title: A newer license is already installed.
older_than_installed.cause: This file is older than the license in use and does not last longer.
older_than_installed.action: Uploading this file is not needed. If your vendor sent it as a correction, ask them for a correction license.

target_limit_reached.title: Your license allows {{max}} targets.
target_limit_reached.cause: {{used}} targets are in use, so no more can be added. Existing targets keep working.
target_limit_reached.action: Remove a target you no longer need, or ask your vendor to increase your license.

unverified.title: The license could not be checked.
unverified.cause: Alice could not check its license for more than 3 hours, so changes to managed systems are paused.
unverified.action: Check that the database is reachable and that no other database session holds the license row. If the license is still valid, changes resume after the next successful check, which is retried at least every 10 minutes.

duplicate.title: A server with this name or address already exists.
duplicate.cause: Every server needs its own name, and the same address and port can be added only once.
duplicate.action: Choose another name, or open the server that already exists.

host_key_unconfirmed.title: The server's fingerprint has not been confirmed yet.
host_key_unconfirmed.cause: Alice works with a server only after an administrator confirms that its fingerprint is the right one.
host_key_unconfirmed.action: Open the server, compare the fingerprint with the one the server shows, then confirm it.

host_key_stale.title: This is not the fingerprint the server presented.
host_key_stale.cause: The server presented another fingerprint after the page was loaded, or the fingerprint was mistyped.
host_key_stale.action: Reload the page and compare the fingerprint shown now with the one on the server.

host_key_changed.title: The server's identity has changed, so Alice stopped to keep your systems safe.
host_key_changed.cause: The server presented another fingerprint than the one you confirmed. This happens after a reinstall, but it can also mean that someone is impersonating the server.
host_key_changed.action: Ask your security team to confirm the change. Then an administrator can review the new fingerprint on the server's page.

host_key_state.title: This fingerprint cannot be accepted right now.
host_key_state.cause: A first fingerprint can be confirmed only while the server waits for confirmation, and a new one can be accepted only after the server's identity changed.
host_key_state.action: Reload the server's page to see its current state.

disabled.title: This server is disabled, so Alice does not work on it.
disabled.cause: The server was disabled, so tasks for it are not run.
disabled.action: Open the server to see why it is disabled, then test the connection again.

unreachable.title: Alice cannot reach the server.
unreachable.cause: The server is turned off, the address or port is wrong, or a firewall blocks the connection.
unreachable.action: Check that the server is running and that the Alice host can reach its SSH port, then test the connection again.

auth_failed.title: The server refused Alice's key.
auth_failed.cause: Alice's public key is missing from the alice-svc account on the server, or the account is locked.
auth_failed.action: Run the preparation commands from the Servers page on the server again, then test the connection.

timeout.title: The server took too long to answer.
timeout.cause: The server or the network is very slow, or a command on the server did not finish in time.
timeout.action: Try again later. If it keeps happening, check the load and the network of the server.

helper_missing.title: The Alice account on this server is not allowed to run the helper.
helper_missing.cause: alice-helper is not installed in /usr/local/libexec, or the sudoers file for alice-svc is missing or wrong.
helper_missing.action: Run the preparation commands from the Servers page again as root on the server.

helper_outdated.title: The alice-helper on this server is outdated.
helper_outdated.cause: The helper on the server is older than this version of Alice expects.
helper_outdated.action: Copy alice-helper from the current Alice bundle to the server and run the preparation commands again.

helper_outdated_rollback_guard.title: Reinstall the helper on this server before Alice replaces this certificate there.
helper_outdated_rollback_guard.cause: The alice-helper on this server is older than 1.9.0 (protocol {{helper_protocol}}; {{required_protocol}} is needed). After a failed change such a helper puts the previous files back without checking them, and the previous certificate here is revoked or compromised, or this place is being replaced in a key compromise incident. Alice sent nothing; every other deployment to this server keeps working.
helper_outdated_rollback_guard.action: Copy alice-helper from the current Alice bundle to the server and run the preparation commands again, then retry the deployment or the incident.

helper_outdated_http01.title: Reinstall the helper on this server to use this proof method.
helper_outdated_http01.cause: The alice-helper or the sudoers file on this server is older than the HTTP-01 proof method needs. Everything else still works on this server.
helper_outdated_http01.action: Copy alice-helper from the current Alice bundle to the server and run the preparation commands again, or use the DNS proof method for this certificate.

helper_refused.title: The helper on the server refused the request.
helper_refused.cause: The helper checks every request and refused this one, for example because a file is outside the places it may read or change.
helper_refused.action: Scan the server again. If it keeps happening, contact support and quote the request ID.

file_changed.title: The file changed while Alice was working. Please try again.
file_changed.cause: Someone or another program changed the authorized_keys file at the same time.
file_changed.action: Try again. Alice reads the file again and applies only its own change.

keys_managed_elsewhere.title: This server gets its SSH keys from a program (AuthorizedKeysCommand), so Alice will not change keys here.
keys_managed_elsewhere.cause: The SSH server asks another program for keys, so a change to a key file would not have the effect you expect.
keys_managed_elsewhere.action: Manage the keys of this server in the system that provides them. Alice still lists the keys it finds in files.

output_too_large.title: The server sent more data than Alice accepts.
output_too_large.cause: A file or a command on the server produced an unusually large answer.
output_too_large.action: Check the server for unusually large content in what Alice reads there: the authorized_keys files, the SSH server settings or the Nginx configuration.

protocol_error.title: Alice could not understand the server's answer.
protocol_error.cause: The helper on the server answered in an unexpected way, possibly because another program replaced it.
protocol_error.action: Install alice-helper again with the preparation commands, then test the connection.

helper_checksums_missing.title: This build of Alice cannot show the commands that prepare a server.
helper_checksums_missing.cause: The Alice program was built without the alice-helper checksums, so the commands could not check the helper before installing it as root.
helper_checksums_missing.action: Install an official Alice release, or build Alice with make build or the image build.

address_not_allowed.title: Alice does not connect to this server's address.
address_not_allowed.cause: The server's name now resolves to an address Alice never connects to: a link-local address such as the cloud metadata address 169.254.169.254, a multicast address or an unspecified address such as 0.0.0.0. The DNS record may have changed, or someone may be trying to make Alice reach a service it must not reach.
address_not_allowed.action: Check the server's DNS record, or remove the server and add it again with its real address. Then test the connection.

own_key_protected.title: Alice needs this key to connect to this server and will not remove it.
own_key_protected.cause: Removing it would lock Alice out of the server. Alice recognizes its key by the key itself, not by its comment.
own_key_protected.action: Leave this key in place. To stop managing the server, remove the server from Alice instead.

last_root_key.title: This is the last key of the root account on this server.
last_root_key.cause: Removing it leaves root without any key, which can lock your administrators out.
last_root_key.action: Add another key for root first, or have an administrator confirm the removal on purpose.

not_removable.title: Alice cannot change this key in this file.
not_removable.cause: The key's line is no longer in the file or was already removed, it is a certificate authority line that Alice only lists, or the file is larger than Alice reads (1 MiB).
not_removable.action: Scan the server again to see its current keys, and check the size of the file on the server.

sshd_unreadable.title: Alice could not read the SSH server settings, so it will not change keys here.
sshd_unreadable.cause: The last scan could not read the SSH server settings for this server or this user, so Alice does not know which key files the SSH server uses.
sshd_unreadable.action: Check that sshd -T works on the server, scan the server again, then try again.

verify_failed.title: Alice changed the key file but could not confirm the result.
verify_failed.cause: After the change, the file on the server did not read back as expected. Alice kept a backup of the previous file and did not record the change.
verify_failed.action: Check the authorized_keys file on the server and compare it with the backup that the task names, then scan the server again.

not_managed.title: Alice holds no private key for this key.
not_managed.cause: Only keys generated in Alice can be deployed, downloaded or rotated. Keys found on servers and Alice's own connection key are only listed.
not_managed.action: Generate a new key in Alice and use that one instead.

retired.title: This key was replaced by a rotation and is no longer used.
retired.cause: A finished rotation retired it. Alice keeps its private key for 30 days for emergencies, then destroys it.
retired.action: Use the newer key that replaced it. The finished rotation of this key names it.

private_key_destroyed.title: The private key of this key was destroyed.
private_key_destroyed.cause: Alice destroys the private key of a retired key 30 days after it was retired.
private_key_destroyed.action: Use the newer key. Backups made before the destruction still contain it in encrypted form.

connection_account.title: Alice does not change the keys of the account it connects with.
connection_account.cause: The chosen user is the account Alice signs in with, or the chosen file is one of that account's key files. The setup commands own that account's key file and write it again whenever they run.
connection_account.action: Choose another user or another file on the server.

login_failed.title: The server did not accept a login with the new key.
login_failed.cause: The key is in the file, but the SSH server refused it: the account may be locked, the server may read another file for this user, or a setting such as AllowUsers leaves the account out.
login_failed.action: Check the account and the SSH server settings for this user, then try again. Alice removes the key it added again; the page shows whether that worked.

generate_busy.title: Alice is busy generating other keys.
generate_busy.cause: Generating an RSA key takes a few seconds, so Alice generates at most two keys at a time.

add_undo_failed.title: Alice could not remove the key again after a failed check.
add_undo_failed.cause: Alice added the key, the check after it failed, and removing the key failed as well (for example, the server could not be reached).
add_undo_failed.action: When the server can be reached, remove the key from this server on the key's page.

not_a_key_file.title: This file is not one of the user's key files.
not_a_key_file.cause: Alice adds keys only to the files the SSH server reads for that user, as the last scan found them.
not_a_key_file.action: Scan the server again, then choose one of the files offered.

connection_files_unknown.title: Alice does not know all key files of the account it connects with on this server.
connection_files_unknown.cause: The last scan did not list every key file the SSH server reads for the account Alice signs in with, so Alice cannot rule out that the chosen file is one of them. Servers last scanned by an earlier version of Alice have no such list.
connection_files_unknown.action: Scan the server again, then try again.

clock_behind.title: Alice's clock is behind a time it already recorded.
clock_behind.cause: The clock of the computer that runs Alice was set back after the last download of this private key. Alice handed out nothing and recorded nothing.
clock_behind.action: Check the time of the computer that runs Alice (NTP), then try again in a moment.

add_uncertain.title: Alice does not know yet whether the key was added.
add_uncertain.cause: The server did not answer Alice's request to add the key, and the key is not in the file yet. The request may still arrive at the server.
add_uncertain.action: Nothing to do now: Alice waits until the request can no longer arrive, then tries again. If this repeats, check the connection to the server.

connection_account_file.title: This place belongs to the account Alice connects with.
connection_account_file.cause: The user is the account Alice signs in with, or the file is one of that account's key files. Alice never changes those: the setup commands own them.
connection_account_file.action: Nothing to do here. Use another user or another file for this key.

in_rotation.title: This key is the new key of a rotation that has not finished.
in_rotation.cause: A running rotation adds this key to its servers itself. If the rotation is stopped or undone, Alice removes the key again wherever it was added, so a key deployed by hand now could disappear with it.
in_rotation.action: Wait until the rotation has finished, or stop it on its page, then deploy the key.

policy_exists.title: This key already has a rotation policy.
policy_exists.cause: Each key has at most one rotation policy.
policy_exists.action: Change the existing policy on the key's page.

in_progress.title: A rotation of this key is already running.
in_progress.cause: Only one rotation runs for a key at a time. A policy with a running rotation cannot be deleted, and the new key of a running rotation cannot get a policy of its own.
in_progress.action: Wait for the rotation to finish, or stop it on its page.

plan_changed.title: The servers or keys changed since the preview.
plan_changed.cause: A rotation runs only exactly as it was previewed, and something changed since then. Nothing was changed on any server.
plan_changed.action: Open the preview again, check it, and start the rotation from there. A scheduled run is previewed again with a new email.

nothing_to_rotate.title: No server can take part in this rotation.
nothing_to_rotate.cause: Every place where the key is used is skipped. The preview shows the reason for each.
nothing_to_rotate.action: Fix the reasons shown in the preview, scan the servers again, then try again.

not_waiting.title: This rotation is not waiting for that action.
not_waiting.cause: The rotation has moved on, or the action does not apply in its current state.
not_waiting.action: Reload the page to see the current state.

add_failed.title: Alice could not add the new key on a server, so it undid the rotation.
add_failed.cause: A server refused the change or could not be reached. The old key was not touched anywhere.
add_failed.action: See the failed server on the rotation's page, fix the problem, then start the rotation again.

verify_failed.title: The new key did not work on a server, so Alice undid the rotation.
verify_failed.cause: Alice could not sign in with the new key there. The old key was not touched anywhere.
verify_failed.action: See the server on the rotation's page, check its SSH settings for that user, then start the rotation again.

undo_failed.title: Alice could not remove the new key from every server.
undo_failed.cause: Undoing the rotation failed on the servers listed on its page: they could not be reached, or the old key was already gone there and Alice kept the new key so that the account keeps a working key. The old key was not touched.
undo_failed.action: When those servers can be reached, remove the new key from them on the new key's page, once another key works for those accounts.

remove_incomplete.title: The old key was kept on some servers.
remove_incomplete.cause: Before removing the old key, Alice checks the new key again. On the servers listed, that check or the removal failed, so the old key stays there.
remove_incomplete.action: Check those servers, then remove the old key from them on the old key's page.

decision_timeout.title: No decision was made within 14 days, so Alice undid the rotation.
decision_timeout.cause: Alice could not test the new key in some places and waited 14 days for an administrator.
decision_timeout.action: Start the rotation again and decide about the places Alice cannot test.

paused_license.title: The rotation is paused because the license has expired or could not be checked.
paused_license.cause: While the license does not allow changes, Alice adds no new key and removes no old key for this rotation, and the old key stays in place.
paused_license.action: Upload a valid license, or wait until Alice can check it again, then choose Continue on the rotation's page.

cancelled_license.title: The planned rotation was cancelled because the license did not allow changes when it was due.
cancelled_license.cause: Alice starts no rotation while the license is expired or cannot be checked.
cancelled_license.action: After a renewal, Alice plans the next run of a policy that is on with a new preview and email.

stopped.title: An administrator stopped the rotation.
stopped.cause: Alice removes the new key again where it had added it; the old key is not touched. The rotation's page shows where this is done.
stopped.action: Start the rotation again when you are ready.

policy_off.title: The planned run was cancelled because the policy was switched off, changed or deleted.
policy_off.cause: A policy that is off starts no run. Changing the interval, the overlap, the notice time or the new key type of a policy that is on switches it off.
policy_off.action: Switch the policy on again to plan the next run.

new_key_failed.title: The new key no longer worked when Alice checked it again, so the old key stays.
new_key_failed.cause: Just before removing the old key, Alice could not sign in with the new key on this server.
new_key_failed.action: Check the new key on this server, then remove the old key on the old key's page when the new key works.

retries_exhausted.title: Alice gave up on this server after several attempts.
retries_exhausted.cause: The work on this server was interrupted again and again (for example, by restarts).
retries_exhausted.action: Check the server and Alice's logs, then start the rotation again.

notice_undelivered.title: The planned rotation was cancelled because its notice email was not delivered in time.
notice_undelivered.cause: A scheduled rotation starts only after its preview email was delivered to at least one administrator before the planned start. Email is not set up, no administrator has an email address, or the mail server did not accept the message in time.
notice_undelivered.action: Check the email settings and the administrators' email addresses. The policy plans its next run one interval later; to rotate now, open the preview and choose Run now.

old_key_gone.title: Alice kept the new key here because the old key is gone.
old_key_gone.cause: While undoing the rotation, Alice found that the old key is no longer in this file, for example because someone removed it after switching to the new key. Removing the new key too could leave the account without a working key.
old_key_gone.action: Find out who uses this account. Remove the new key on the new key's page only after another key works for it.

plan_too_large.title: This rotation has too many places for one run.
plan_too_large.cause: A run holds at most 10 000 places, and its stored plan must fit in 2 MiB. Nothing was created or changed.
plan_too_large.action: Use separate keys for groups of servers and give each key its own policy.

start_failed.title: Alice could not start the rotation, so it cancelled the run.
start_failed.cause: Run now created the run, but starting it failed, for example because Alice was busy generating other keys. Nothing was changed on any server.
start_failed.action: Choose Run now again in a moment.

notice_pending.title: Alice is still preparing the email about the license renewal.
notice_pending.cause: After a renewal, Alice emails the administrators before a paused rotation may continue. The next background check queues that email, within about a minute. Nothing was changed.
notice_pending.action: Continue becomes available once the email about the renewal has been queued, usually within a minute.

late_result.title: A server's answer arrived after Alice had given up on it.
late_result.cause: Alice had stopped waiting for this place after several attempts. Its answer came later, so the rotation's record and the key file on the server may differ there.
late_result.action: Open the rotation's page and check the key file on this server, then scan the server again so that Alice lists its keys as they are.

guard_refused.title: Alice stopped working on this place because the database refused its records.
guard_refused.cause: The database's safety checks refused to record a step of this place, for example because the old key's place became Alice's own connection key after the removal was sent. Alice did nothing more there.
guard_refused.action: Check this place on the rotation's page and the server's keys, then report it together with Alice's logs.

skipped_at_send.title: This place was skipped when Alice was about to change it.
skipped_at_send.cause: When Alice was about to send the change, the server's last scan showed a reason the plan skips; the place's skip reason names it. Alice sent nothing more there; if the new key had already been sent, undoing the rotation removes it again.
skipped_at_send.action: Fix the skip reason shown on the rotation's page, scan the server again, then start the rotation again.

listing_incomplete.title: Alice could not read this account's key file completely.
listing_incomplete.cause: The file could not be read in full on every attempt (for example it is not a regular file, it cannot be read, or it is too large), so Alice could not prove whether a key is in it and stopped working on this place.
listing_incomplete.action: Make the file a readable regular file on the server, scan the server again, then start a new rotation.

queue_failed.title: Alice could not queue the email about the license renewal.
queue_failed.cause: Writing the email to Alice's outbox failed. A paused rotation continues only after that email is queued, and Alice tries again at every background check.
queue_failed.action: Check Alice's logs and its database, then choose Continue again once the email is queued.

smtp_not_configured.title: Mail settings are missing.
smtp_not_configured.cause: Alice has no mail server to send through.
smtp_not_configured.action: Enter the mail server in Settings, then try again.

smtp_connect.title: Alice could not reach the mail server.
smtp_connect.cause: The server name or port may be wrong, the server may be down, or a firewall blocks the connection.
smtp_connect.action: Check the server name and port, then send a test e-mail again.

smtp_tls.title: The encrypted connection to the mail server failed.
smtp_tls.cause: The server does not offer the selected encryption (STARTTLS or TLS), or the handshake failed.
smtp_tls.action: Choose the encryption the server offers (port 587 usually uses STARTTLS, port 465 TLS), then try again.

smtp_untrusted.title: Alice does not trust the mail server's certificate.
smtp_untrusted.cause: The certificate is not signed by a trusted authority, does not match the server name, or has expired. Its fingerprint is shown below.
smtp_untrusted.action: Check with your mail administrator that the fingerprint is the server's, then choose Trust this certificate, or add your organisation's certificate authority.

smtp_auth.title: The mail server rejected the user name or password.
smtp_auth.cause: The sign-in data in the mail settings are wrong or the account is locked at the mail server.
smtp_auth.action: Enter the correct user name and password, then send a test e-mail again.

smtp_rejected.title: The mail server refused the message.
smtp_rejected.cause: The sender or recipient address is not accepted by the server.
smtp_rejected.action: Check the sender address and the recipient, then try again.

certificate_not_seen.title: Alice did not see this certificate recently.
certificate_not_seen.cause: Only a certificate that a test e-mail found in the last hour can be trusted.
certificate_not_seen.action: Send a test e-mail again, then trust the certificate it shows.

smtp_address_refused.title: Alice does not connect to this mail server address.
smtp_address_refused.cause: The server name points to a link-local or cloud metadata address, which Alice never contacts.
smtp_address_refused.action: Use the mail server's normal address.

too_large.title: The export is too large.
too_large.cause: An export holds at most {{max}} rows, and this filter matches more.
too_large.action: Narrow the filter, for example by server or expiry, then export again.

busy.title: Another export of yours is still running.
busy.cause: Each person can run one export at a time, and your previous export has not finished yet.
busy.action: Wait until the previous download has finished, then export again.

limit_reached.title: You have reached the limit of saved views.
limit_reached.cause: A person can keep at most {{max}} saved views.
limit_reached.action: Delete a view you no longer need, then save again.

name_taken.title: A saved view with this name already exists.
name_taken.cause: Each of your views on a page needs its own name.

discovery_failed.title: Alice could not read the identity provider's settings.
discovery_failed.cause: Its discovery document or key list could not be fetched or is not valid (reason: {{cause}}).
discovery_failed.action: Check the issuer address and, for a private certificate authority, its certificate, then try again.

admin_mapping_disabled.title: A group cannot be mapped to Administrator.
admin_mapping_disabled.cause: SSO users may be Admin is switched off, so single sign-on and directory users can be at most Operators.
admin_mapping_disabled.action: Switch on SSO users may be Admin first, or map the group to another role.

admin_mappings_exist.title: SSO users may be Admin cannot be switched off yet.
admin_mappings_exist.cause: Some groups of an identity provider or a directory are still mapped to Administrator.
admin_mappings_exist.action: Remove those mappings, then switch the setting off.

public_url_missing.title: Alice's address is not set.
public_url_missing.cause: The identity provider sends users back to Alice's address, and Alice does not know it yet.
public_url_missing.action: Enter Alice's address under Settings, General, then try again.

provider_in_use.title: This identity provider still has users.
provider_in_use.cause: People have signed in through it, so it cannot be deleted.
provider_in_use.action: Switch the provider off instead, or remove its users first.

no_access.title: Your account has no access to Alice, contact your administrator.
no_access.cause: You signed in at your identity provider, but none of your groups is given a role in Alice.
no_access.action: Ask your administrator to add your group to Alice's group mappings.

groups_overage.title: Your identity provider did not send your groups.
groups_overage.cause: You are a member of more groups than it puts into a sign-in, so it left them all out.
groups_overage.action: Ask your administrator to send only the groups assigned to Alice's application (Microsoft Entra ID: "Groups assigned to the application").

email_in_use.title: Single sign-on was refused for this e-mail address.
email_in_use.cause: A local Alice account already uses this e-mail address, and Alice never joins a single sign-on identity to a local account.
email_in_use.action: Ask your administrator to change or remove the local account's e-mail address, then sign in again.

idp_unreachable.title: Alice could not reach the identity provider.
idp_unreachable.cause: The identity provider is down or the network path to it is blocked.
idp_unreachable.action: Try again later. Administrators can still sign in with their local account and authenticator code.

login_invalid.title: The sign-in answer of the identity provider was not accepted.
login_invalid.cause: Alice could not confirm that the answer really came from your identity provider for this sign-in.
login_invalid.action: Sign in again. If this keeps happening, ask your administrator to check the single sign-on settings.

login_expired.title: This sign-in has expired.
login_expired.cause: A sign-in must be finished within 10 minutes and in the same browser, and each one can be used only once.

provider_disabled.title: This sign-in option is switched off.
provider_disabled.cause: An administrator switched off this identity provider in Alice.
provider_disabled.action: Use another sign-in option or contact your administrator.

stepup_other_user.title: The confirmation was made with another account.
stepup_other_user.cause: You confirmed at the identity provider as a different person than the one signed in to Alice.
stepup_other_user.action: Confirm again with your own account.

idp_error.title: The identity provider ended the sign-in.
idp_error.cause: It answered with an error, for example because the sign-in was cancelled or Alice's address is not registered there.
idp_error.action: Try again. If this keeps happening, ask your administrator to check that Alice's address is registered at the identity provider.

not_sso_user.title: Your account does not use single sign-on.
not_sso_user.cause: Only single sign-on users confirm at the identity provider.
not_sso_user.action: Confirm with your authenticator code instead.

signin_refused.title: The user name or password is wrong, or you have no access.
signin_refused.cause: The directory did not accept this user name and password, none of your groups is given a role in Alice, or your account cannot sign in at the moment.
signin_refused.action: Check the user name and password and try again. If it keeps failing, ask your administrator.

directory_unavailable.title: The directory cannot be used for sign-in right now.
directory_unavailable.cause: Alice could not reach the directory, its settings do not work, or sign-in through it is switched off.
directory_unavailable.action: Try again later or choose another sign-in option. Administrators can still sign in with their local account and authenticator code.

directory_in_use.title: This directory has users.
directory_in_use.cause: People have signed in through this directory, so it cannot be deleted and its unique ID attribute cannot be changed.
directory_in_use.action: Switch sign-in through the directory off instead.

connection_test_failed.title: The connection test failed.
connection_test_failed.cause: Alice could not bind as the service account or search the user base DN (reason: {{reason}}, step: {{detail}}).
connection_test_failed.action: Check the addresses, the certificate authority, the service account and the user base DN, then test again.

too_many_directories.title: No more directories can be added.
too_many_directories.cause: Alice works with at most {{max}} directories.
too_many_directories.action: Delete a directory you no longer use, or change an existing one.

signin_test_failed.title: The sign-in test failed.
signin_test_failed.cause: The directory refused the test sign-in (reason: {{reason}}, step: {{detail}}). Nobody was signed in.
signin_test_failed.action: Check the user name and password, the user filter and the sign-in name attribute, then test again.

enrolment_required.title: Set up your authenticator first.
enrolment_required.cause: This directory asks for an authenticator code, and your account has none yet.
enrolment_required.action: Sign out and sign in again: Alice then sets up your authenticator.

not_directory_user.title: Your account does not sign in through a directory.
not_directory_user.cause: Only directory users confirm with their directory password.
not_directory_user.action: Confirm with your authenticator code instead.

user_not_directory.title: This user does not sign in through a directory.
user_not_directory.cause: Only a directory user's sign-in can be locked after failed directory passwords.
user_not_directory.action: For a local account's sign-in delay or lockout, use alice admin unlock on the host.

not_waiting.title: This task is not waiting for a confirmation.
not_waiting.cause: It already ran, was discarded, or was not paused because of the license.
not_waiting.action: Reload the page to see the current state of the task.

lease_expired.title: The task was interrupted and will run again.
lease_expired.cause: Alice stopped or lost its database connection while the task was running.
lease_expired.action: Nothing to do: Alice runs the task again. If this keeps happening, check why Alice restarts.

tampered.title: Alice refused to run a task that was changed outside Alice.
tampered.cause: The stored task no longer matches its protection, which means that someone edited the database directly.
tampered.action: Check who has access to the database, then start the task again from its page.

unknown_type.title: Alice does not know this kind of task.
unknown_type.cause: The task was created by another version of Alice.
unknown_type.action: Make sure that only one version of Alice runs against this database.

conflict.title: The same task is already waiting with other options.
conflict.cause: A task of this kind is already queued for this item, and it was requested with different options.
conflict.action: Wait until the queued task has finished, then try again.

not_found.title: Nginx was not found on this server.
not_found.cause: Alice looked for /usr/sbin/nginx, where the standard packages install it.
not_found.action: Install Nginx from your distribution or nginx.org, or add this server as a Linux server.

config_invalid.title: Nginx's configuration has a problem, so Alice will not deploy to this server until it is fixed.
config_invalid.cause: Nginx's configuration has an error, or it uses files or settings Alice cannot safely read. Nothing was changed.
config_invalid.action: Run nginx -t on the server and fix any error. If it passes, check the file named on the server's page, then choose Discover again.

config_changed.title: The Nginx configuration changed since Alice last looked.
config_changed.cause: This website no longer uses the certificate and key files Alice found. Nothing was changed.
config_changed.action: Choose Discover on the server's page, then deploy again.

profile_missing.title: This server is not prepared for Nginx work.
profile_missing.cause: The Alice account may run alice-helper for SSH keys only (Linux profile), not for certificates.
profile_missing.action: On the Servers page choose Server type Nginx server, copy the commands and run them on the server again.

no_space.title: The server does not have enough free disk space.
no_space.cause: Alice needs room for the new files and a backup of the old ones. Nothing was changed.
no_space.action: Free some space on the server, then deploy again.

file_changed.title: The certificate file changed since Alice last looked.
file_changed.cause: Someone or another tool replaced the file after the last discovery. Nothing was changed.
file_changed.action: Choose Discover on the server's page, check the website, then deploy again.

location_unsupported.title: Alice cannot change certificates at this place.
location_unsupported.cause: The website's certificate setup is one Alice does not support, its files no longer meet Alice's safety rules (for example a folder that users other than root can change), or the website no longer uses this file. Nothing was changed.
location_unsupported.action: Choose Discover on the server's page to see the reason next to the website, and change the setup on the server if you want Alice to manage it.

busy.title: Another certificate change is running on this server.
busy.cause: alice-helper changes one website at a time on a server.
busy.action: Wait a minute and try again.

io_error.title: The server could not complete the file work. Nothing was changed.
io_error.cause: alice-helper reported an input or output error before it replaced any file, for example a folder it cannot write, a read-only file system, or Nginx stopping while it was checked.
io_error.action: Check the server's disks and certificate folders, then deploy again.

not_running.title: Nginx is not running on the server. Nothing was changed.
not_running.cause: alice-helper checks before it changes any file that systemctl exists and that the nginx service is active; otherwise a reload could not apply the new certificate.
not_running.action: Run systemctl status nginx on the server, start Nginx (systemctl start nginx), then deploy again.

not_found.title: Apache was not found on this server.
not_found.cause: Alice looked for /usr/sbin/apache2ctl (Debian, Ubuntu) and /usr/sbin/httpd (Red Hat family), where the standard packages install Apache.
not_found.action: Install Apache from your distribution or add this server as a Linux server. docs/apache-host-preparation.md lists what Alice expects.

config_invalid.title: Apache's configuration has a problem, so Alice cannot read this server's certificates until it is fixed.
config_invalid.cause: Apache's configuration has an error, or it uses files or settings Alice cannot safely read. Nothing was changed.
config_invalid.action: Run apache2ctl -t (Debian, Ubuntu) or httpd -t (Red Hat family) on the server and fix any error. If it passes, check the file named on the server's page and docs/apache-host-preparation.md, then choose Discover again.

profile_missing.title: This server is not prepared for Apache work.
profile_missing.cause: The Alice account may run alice-helper for SSH keys only (Linux profile), not for Apache.
profile_missing.action: On the Servers page choose Server type Apache server, copy the commands and run them on the server again. docs/apache-host-preparation.md describes the preparation.

helper_too_old.title: The alice-helper on this server is too old to read Apache.
helper_too_old.cause: Reading Apache needs alice-helper 1.7.0 or newer, and the one installed on the server is older.
helper_too_old.action: The Apache profile needs alice-helper 1.7.0 or newer. On the Servers page choose Server type Apache server, copy the commands and run them on the server again to install it. docs/apache-host-preparation.md describes the steps.

not_found.title: HAProxy was not found on this server.
not_found.cause: Alice looked for /usr/sbin/haproxy, where the standard packages install HAProxy.
not_found.action: Install HAProxy from your distribution or add this server as a Linux server. docs/haproxy-host-preparation.md lists what Alice expects.

config_invalid.title: HAProxy's configuration has a problem, so Alice cannot read this server's certificates until it is fixed.
config_invalid.cause: HAProxy's configuration has an error, or it uses files or settings Alice cannot safely read. Nothing was changed.
config_invalid.action: Run haproxy -c -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg on the server and fix any error. If it passes, check the file named on the server's page and docs/haproxy-host-preparation.md, then choose Discover again.

profile_missing.title: This server is not prepared for HAProxy work.
profile_missing.cause: The Alice account may run alice-helper for SSH keys only (Linux profile), not for HAProxy.
profile_missing.action: On the Servers page choose Server type HAProxy server, copy the commands and run them on the server again. docs/haproxy-host-preparation.md describes the preparation.

helper_too_old.title: The alice-helper on this server is too old to read HAProxy.
helper_too_old.cause: Reading HAProxy needs alice-helper 1.8.0 or newer, and the one installed on the server is older.
helper_too_old.action: The HAProxy profile needs alice-helper 1.8.0 or newer. On the Servers page choose Server type HAProxy server, copy the commands and run them on the server again to install it. docs/haproxy-host-preparation.md describes the steps.

invalid.title: This is not a certificate Alice can read.
invalid.cause: Alice expects PEM text with BEGIN CERTIFICATE blocks, or a PFX file. During a deployment, the stored certificate could not be sent to the server in that form.
invalid.action: When uploading, check that you chose the certificate file, not a request or another file. After a deployment, look at the deployment's steps: if the certificate file itself is at fault, upload a corrected certificate and deploy that one. If it happens again, report the deployment's ID (for an upload, the request ID).

key_mismatch.title: The certificate does not match its private key.
key_mismatch.cause: When uploading: the private key belongs to another certificate. During a deployment: after the new files were written, nginx -t reported that a certificate and its key file on the server do not belong together.
key_mismatch.action: When uploading, use the key that was created together with this certificate. After a deployment, check which certificate and key files the websites on this server use; the deployment's status shows whether the previous files are back.

expired.title: This certificate has already expired.
expired.cause: Its validity period has ended, so browsers would refuse it.
expired.action: Get a renewed certificate from your certificate authority and upload that one.

key_encrypted.title: The private key is protected with a password.
key_encrypted.cause: Alice cannot store a key it cannot read.
key_encrypted.action: Remove the password from the key, or upload a PFX file and enter its password.

pfx_password.title: The PFX password is wrong or the file is damaged.
pfx_password.cause: Alice could not open the PFX file with this password.
pfx_password.action: Check the password, or export the PFX file again.

weak.title: This certificate or one in its chain uses a weak key or signature.
weak.cause: RSA keys shorter than 2048 bits and MD5 or SHA-1 signatures are no longer safe.
weak.action: Ask your certificate authority for a certificate with a stronger key and a SHA-256 signature.

unsupported_key.title: Alice supports RSA and ECDSA certificates only.
unsupported_key.cause: This certificate uses another key type (for example Ed25519), another curve, or an RSA key larger than 16384 bits.
unsupported_key.action: Use a certificate with an RSA key of 2048 to 16384 bits, or an ECDSA P-256 or P-384 key.

duplicate.title: Alice already has this certificate with its key.
duplicate.cause: This certificate and its key are already stored, from an earlier upload or a signing request.
duplicate.action: Open the certificate in the list and deploy it from there.

no_private_key.title: Alice does not have the private key of this certificate.
no_private_key.cause: Alice found this certificate on a server, and private keys are never read from servers.
no_private_key.action: Upload the certificate together with its key, then deploy it.

key_type_mismatch.title: This certificate's key type does not fit this place.
key_type_mismatch.cause: Key type the website uses here: {{expected}}. Key type of this certificate: {{actual}}.
key_type_mismatch.action: Choose a certificate with the same key type, or the website's other certificate place.

chain_unconfirmed.title: An administrator must confirm the incomplete chain of this certificate.
chain_unconfirmed.cause: The certificate chain does not reach a trusted root, so some browsers may not trust it.
chain_unconfirmed.action: Ask an administrator to deploy it and confirm the chain.

not_yet_valid.title: This certificate is not valid yet.
not_yet_valid.cause: Its validity period has not started, so browsers would refuse it.
not_yet_valid.action: Deploy it once its validity period has started, or check the clock of the Alice host.

pfx_busy.title: Alice is busy reading other PFX files.
pfx_busy.cause: Alice reads at most two PFX files at a time, and that limit was reached. Nothing was stored or sent to a server.
pfx_busy.action: Wait a moment and try again.

revoked.title: This certificate was revoked.
revoked.cause: Its certificate authority revoked it at Alice's request. Browsers may refuse a revoked certificate, so Alice never deploys it again.
revoked.action: Deploy a newer certificate instead. For a certificate from a certificate authority (ACME), choose Order now on its page; Alice also orders a new one by herself while automatic renewal is on.

compromised.title: This certificate's private key is marked compromised.
compromised.cause: An administrator started a key compromise incident for this certificate or for another certificate made with the same private key. Alice never deploys a certificate with a compromised key again.
compromised.action: Deploy the replacement chosen in the incident, or another certificate made with a new key. Open the incident from the certificate's page to follow the replacement.

not_pending.title: This signing request is no longer open.
not_pending.action: Create a new signing request if you need one.

certificate_mismatch.title: This certificate was not issued for this signing request.
certificate_mismatch.cause: Its public key is not the one Alice created for the request.
certificate_mismatch.action: Paste the certificate your certificate authority returned for this request.

busy.title: Alice is busy creating other signing requests.
busy.cause: Alice creates the keys of at most two signing requests at a time, and that limit was reached. Nothing was stored.
busy.action: Wait a moment and create the signing request again.

too_many_pending.title: There are too many open signing requests.
too_many_pending.cause: Alice keeps at most 1000 open signing requests for the whole installation (for all users together), and that limit was reached. Nothing was created.
too_many_pending.action: Complete or cancel the signing requests you no longer need, then create this one again.

in_progress.title: Another deployment to this website is in progress.
in_progress.cause: Alice runs one deployment per certificate file at a time.
in_progress.action: Wait until it finishes; its progress is in the deployment history.

recovery_pending.title: Alice is still finishing an earlier deployment on this server.
recovery_pending.cause: An earlier deployment on this server did not end normally, and Alice must first find out how it ended and finish it.
recovery_pending.action: Wait until that deployment shows its result in the deployment history, then deploy again.

verify_failed.title: The website still serves the previous certificate.
verify_failed.cause: After the change the website kept serving the previous certificate, for example because the website's configuration sends this name to another website, or Nginx was not reloaded. The deployment's status shows whether the previous files are back.
verify_failed.action: Check which part of the Nginx configuration answers for this website's name, then deploy again.

verify_other.title: Alice could not confirm which certificate the website serves.
verify_other.cause: The website served a certificate that is neither the previous nor the new one (for example from a load balancer in front of it), or Alice has not read the website's current certificate yet. The deployment's status shows whether anything was changed.
verify_other.action: Choose Discover on the server's page. If the website is behind another server, an administrator can set the port and name to check in its verification settings.

verify_unreachable.title: Alice could not reach the website on port {{port}}.
verify_unreachable.cause: Neither Alice nor the server itself could connect to the website, or the website has no HTTPS address Alice can check. The certificate it serves could not be checked. The deployment's status shows whether anything was changed.
verify_unreachable.action: Allow Alice to reach this port, or ask an administrator to change the website's verification settings.

reload_failed.title: Nginx did not reload.
reload_failed.cause: systemctl reload nginx failed after the new files were written. The deployment's status shows whether the previous files are back.
reload_failed.action: Run systemctl status nginx on the server to see why, then deploy again.

config_test_failed.title: Nginx rejected the new files.
config_test_failed.cause: nginx -t failed after the new certificate and key were written. The deployment's status shows whether the previous files are back.
config_test_failed.action: Check the certificate file format and the chain, then deploy again.

rollback_failed.title: Alice could not confirm that the previous certificate is back. Manual action is needed.
rollback_failed.cause: The deployment failed, and putting the previous certificate and key back did not finish or could not be confirmed. A backup of the previous files is on the server in /var/lib/alice-helper/backups, in the folder named with this deployment's ID.
rollback_failed.action: Check the website now. Compare the files with the backup on the server, then run nginx -t and systemctl reload nginx.

rollback_reload_failed.title: Files are back in place but Nginx did not reload.
rollback_reload_failed.cause: Alice restored the previous certificate and key, but systemctl reload nginx failed afterwards.
rollback_reload_failed.action: Run systemctl status nginx on the server, fix the cause, then reload Nginx.

interrupted.title: The deployment did not finish normally.
interrupted.cause: While the deployment ran, the connection to the server was lost, Alice restarted, or the server could not finish writing the files. The deployment's status shows which certificate the server has; if Alice does not know yet, it keeps checking.
interrupted.action: Check the deployment history. Once it shows a result, deploy again if needed.

target_not_ready.title: Alice cannot deploy to this server now.
target_not_ready.cause: The server is not connected: its host key fingerprint is not confirmed or has changed, Alice cannot sign in, or the server is disabled.
target_not_ready.action: Open the server's page, solve the problem shown there, then deploy again.

verify_chain.title: The website serves the expected certificate with a different chain (port {{port}}).
verify_chain.cause: The number of certificates the website sends differs from the chain Alice expected, for example because another file or a proxy adds or drops intermediate certificates. The deployment's status shows whether anything was changed.
verify_chain.action: Check which certificate files this website's configuration uses, then deploy again.

verify_untrusted.title: The website serves the new certificate, but its chain is not trusted (port {{port}}).
verify_untrusted.cause: The certificate chain the website sends does not verify against the certificate authority Alice knows for this certificate: an intermediate certificate is missing, wrong, out of order or expired, or the chain leads to a root Alice does not trust. Alice put the previous certificate back. The deployment's verification shows the exact fault.
verify_untrusted.action: Check which certificate and chain files this website's configuration uses, and that nothing in front of the server (a proxy or a load balancer) sends another chain, then deploy again.

drift_repair_superseded.title: The repair was not started: the location no longer needs this certificate.
drift_repair_superseded.cause: Between the planning of the automatic repair and its start, the location's binding was removed or its certificate was renewed. Nothing was changed on the server.
drift_repair_superseded.action: Nothing to do: the next check of the location decides again.

drift_repair_off.title: The repair was not started: automatic repair is off for this location.
drift_repair_off.cause: After the repair was planned, a person chose another repair mode for the location, or automatic repair stopped because the repairs kept coming back or failing. Nothing was changed on the server.
drift_repair_off.action: Choose Repair on the server's page to deploy the right certificate now, or choose automatic repair again.

drift_not_bound.title: This location follows no certificate.
drift_not_bound.cause: A repair mode and a repair need the certificate the location should have: an issued (ACME) certificate or a Key Vault binding that the location is bound to.
drift_not_bound.action: Bind the location to a certificate first.

not_drifted.title: This location does not need a repair.
not_drifted.cause: The newest checks of the location agree with the certificate it should have, or the certificate has not been deployed there yet.
not_drifted.action: Nothing to repair. To deploy the certificate anyway, use Deploy now on the certificate's page.

nothing_to_restore.title: There was nothing to restore.
nothing_to_restore.cause: alice-helper found that this deployment had not changed any file, so there was nothing to put back.
nothing_to_restore.action: Check the deployment's result in the deployment history, then deploy again if needed.

superseded.title: A later change replaced the files, so Alice did not restore them.
superseded.cause: While Alice was finishing this deployment, a later operation on the server replaced the certificate files. Alice cannot tell what they hold now.
superseded.action: Check which certificate the website serves now, then choose Discover on the server's page.

unknown_operation.title: The server has no record of this deployment.
unknown_operation.cause: alice-helper has no record of this deployment, for example because it never received it or because it removed the record after 7 days or more.
unknown_operation.action: Check which certificate the website serves now, then choose Discover on the server's page.

target_deleted.title: The server was deleted before the deployment finished.
target_deleted.cause: The server was removed from Alice while this deployment was waiting or running. If a change had already reached the server, Alice cannot check it any more.
target_deleted.action: If the server still exists, check its website and the certificate files on it.

recovery_exhausted.title: Alice stopped trying to finish this deployment. Manual action is needed.
recovery_exhausted.cause: For about a day Alice could not find out how the deployment ended, usually because it could not reach the server. If the change reached the server, a backup of the previous files is there in /var/lib/alice-helper/backups, in the folder named with this deployment's ID.
recovery_exhausted.action: Check the website and the server's connection now, then choose Discover on the server's page.

outcome_unknown.title: Alice cannot tell how this deployment ended. Manual action is needed.
outcome_unknown.cause: Alice no longer has the records it needs to check or undo this deployment. If the change reached the server, a backup of the previous files is there in /var/lib/alice-helper/backups, in the folder named with this deployment's ID.
outcome_unknown.action: Check the website now, then choose Discover on the server's page.

restored_unverified.title: The previous files are back, but the website was not confirmed.
restored_unverified.cause: Alice put the previous certificate and key back, but then could not confirm that the website serves the previous certificate again.
restored_unverified.action: Check the website now. If it is wrong, run nginx -t and systemctl reload nginx on the server.

rollback_file_changed.title: Another program changed the certificate files during the deployment. Manual action is needed.
rollback_file_changed.cause: While Alice was deploying or putting the previous files back, another program changed the certificate or key file. Alice never overwrites that program's file: it put back at most the files it had written itself, so the certificate and key on the server may not belong together now. A backup of the previous files is on the server in /var/lib/alice-helper/backups, in the folder named with this deployment's ID.
rollback_file_changed.action: Run nginx -t on the server now: if it fails, the certificate and key do not belong together. Find out which program changed the files (for example certbot), put a matching pair back from that program or from the backup, check the website, then choose Discover on the server's page.

rescan_needed.title: Alice must read this website's files again before deploying.
rescan_needed.cause: Alice does not know the current content of the certificate file, which it needs to make sure nobody changed the file in the meantime.
rescan_needed.action: Choose Discover on the server's page, then deploy again.

cancelled.title: An administrator cancelled this deployment before anything was sent to the server.
cancelled.cause: An administrator chose Discard for the deployment's waiting job, so Alice sent nothing to the server. The website keeps its previous certificate.
cancelled.action: Deploy the certificate again if it is still needed.

rollback_forbidden.title: The change failed, and Alice did not put the previous certificate back because it is revoked or compromised.
rollback_forbidden.cause: The new certificate could not be put in service, and the files from before the change hold a certificate that was revoked or whose private key is compromised. Alice never puts such a certificate or key back on a server, so the files stay as the failed change left them. The website may not work until another certificate is deployed.
rollback_forbidden.action: Check the website now. Find and fix the cause shown in the deployment history (the configuration test, the reload or the check of the website), then deploy a valid certificate again or choose Retry on the incident. Never restore the server's backup of this change by hand: it holds the compromised key.

pending_change_restored.title: Alice undid an unfinished earlier change of these files; this certificate was not deployed.
pending_change_restored.cause: An earlier change of these certificate files on the server did not finish, and Alice no longer followed it. Alice put back the files that change had replaced, so the website now serves the certificate from before that change. The certificate of this deployment was not written.
pending_change_restored.action: Choose Discover on the server's page so that Alice reads the files again, then deploy the certificate again.

server_operation_pending.title: An unfinished change of these certificate files on the server stops new changes.
server_operation_pending.cause: An earlier change of these files on the server did not finish, and Alice no longer follows it, so the server refuses new changes. Alice did not put back the files that change replaced: either it does not restore that change (Alice knows it from another website, or as a change that ended normally), or its attempt did not finish, in which case it may have put back one of the two files. This deployment's certificate was not written.
server_operation_pending.action: The deployment's details name the unfinished change (operation id). On the server, as root, run /usr/local/libexec/alice-helper nginx-restore --op followed by that id, then run nginx -t, and deploy again.

auth_failed.title: Azure sign-in refused
auth_failed.cause: Alice could not sign in to Azure with these details.
auth_failed.action: Check the tenant ID, application ID and secret or certificate.

credentials_expired.title: Azure sign-in secret expired
credentials_expired.cause: The secret or certificate Alice uses to sign in to Azure has expired.
credentials_expired.action: Create a new one in Azure and replace it on the vault's page in Alice.

forbidden.title: Missing permission in the vault
forbidden.cause: Alice is signed in to Azure, but the vault does not allow what Alice tried.
forbidden.action: Ask your Azure administrator to give Alice's identity the role {{role}} on this vault (or the matching access policy).

firewall.title: Vault firewall blocks Alice
firewall.cause: The vault's firewall does not allow connections from this Alice server.
firewall.action: Add Alice's address to the vault's allowed networks, or use a private endpoint.

vault_not_found.title: Vault not found
vault_not_found.cause: The vault address cannot be found.
vault_not_found.action: Check the name and network access (private endpoints need internal DNS).

unreachable.title: Cannot reach Azure
unreachable.cause: Alice could not connect to Azure or to the vault. Nothing was changed.
unreachable.action: Check that this Alice server can reach login.microsoftonline.com and the vault's address on port 443. Alice tries again by itself.

throttled.title: Azure asked Alice to slow down
throttled.cause: Azure is asking Alice to slow down.
throttled.action: Alice retries automatically; nothing to do unless this continues for an hour.

unexpected_response.title: Unexpected answer from Azure
unexpected_response.cause: Azure answered in a way Alice does not understand. Nothing was changed.
unexpected_response.action: Alice tries again by itself. If this continues, give your administrator the request ID shown here.

clock_skew.title: Server clock rejected by Azure
clock_skew.cause: The clock on the Alice server appears to be wrong, so Azure rejected the sign-in.

managed_identity_unavailable.title: Managed identity not available
managed_identity_unavailable.cause: Alice could not get a managed identity from this machine. A managed identity exists only on an Azure virtual machine (or a similar Azure service) that has one assigned.
managed_identity_unavailable.action: Assign a managed identity to this machine in Azure, or sign in with a certificate or a client secret instead.

address_not_allowed.title: Azure address not allowed
address_not_allowed.cause: Alice connects only to Azure's public sign-in address and to the vault's own address. Either the vault's name led to an address that is not the vault's, or Alice's own environment holds a setting that is not allowed: the region variables send the sign-in to another host, and the SDK-logging variable makes the Azure library print Azure's answers to the log.
address_not_allowed.action: Check that the vault address is a public Key Vault address whose name resolves to the vault itself. Ask whoever runs Alice to remove the variables AZURE_REGIONAL_AUTHORITY_NAME, MSAL_FORCE_REGION and AZURE_SDK_GO_LOGGING from Alice's environment and to restart Alice.

tls_untrusted.title: Azure's certificate is not trusted
tls_untrusted.cause: The certificate that Azure presented is not trusted by this Alice server, for example because a company proxy replaces it.
tls_untrusted.action: Make sure Alice connects to Azure directly, without a proxy that replaces certificates, and that the server's clock is correct.

not_exportable.title: Private key not exportable
not_exportable.cause: This certificate's private key cannot be exported from Azure Key Vault (its policy says so, or the vault returned it without its key), so Alice cannot copy it to a server.
not_exportable.action: Create a new version of the certificate with 'Exportable private key' turned on, or upload a different certificate.

version_disabled.title: Version disabled in Key Vault
version_disabled.cause: This version is disabled in Key Vault, so it was not deployed.
version_disabled.action: Enable it in Key Vault or deploy another version.

certificate_not_found.title: Certificate no longer in the vault
certificate_not_found.cause: This certificate no longer exists in the vault.
certificate_not_found.action: Restore it in Key Vault, or remove its connection to websites.

secret_unreadable.title: Certificate data could not be read
secret_unreadable.cause: The certificate data from Azure could not be used: it had no private key (the certificate's key is not exportable), or it was not a certificate with its key in PFX or PEM form. Nothing was changed on your servers.
secret_unreadable.action: If the certificate's page now shows Monitor only, its key is not exportable: create a new version with 'Exportable private key' turned on. Otherwise check the certificate's content type in Key Vault (PFX or PEM) and whether its key is exportable.

secret_mismatch.title: Vault data does not match the version
secret_mismatch.cause: The data the vault returned is not the certificate version Alice expected (another certificate or another key). Nothing was changed on your servers.
secret_mismatch.action: Use Check now on the vault's page, then deploy again. If this happens again, look at the certificate in Key Vault.

location_bound.title: Website already connected
location_bound.cause: This website is already connected to another certificate (in a vault, or from a certificate authority), and a website can follow only one.
location_bound.action: Disconnect it from the other certificate first, or leave it out of this selection.

binding_exists.title: Certificate already connected
binding_exists.cause: This vault certificate already has connected websites.
binding_exists.action: Change the websites of the existing connection instead of creating a new one.

vault_has_bindings.title: Vault still has connected websites
vault_has_bindings.cause: Websites are still connected to certificates of this vault. Removing the vault would stop their automatic updates.
